verdict_scope: The preregistration is complete and internally executable as a measurement specification. No baseline run, model result, or scientific claim has passed.
research_question: Under the frozen declared VMem component variant and two-batch return trajectory, is there a repeatable severe RGB return discrepancy on a predeclared outer-region mask?

single_primary_endpoint.name: ReturnPSNR_M
single_primary_endpoint.cohort_rule: All B0/C1/C2 rows must be technically valid and executed. At least two of three rows must have unrounded float64 MSE_M > 0.01.
single_primary_endpoint.equality_rule: MSE_M == 0.01, equivalently 20.0 dB, is not a failure
single_primary_endpoint.threshold_interpretation: Preregistered severe-drift engineering screen; not a community standard and not a detector of every subtle failure.

frozen_mask.aggregation: union pixels and RGB channels are combined in float64 before MSE; PSNR is a monotonic display transform of the same MSE

confirmation_scene_selection_rule: From the same local VMem test_samples directory, exclude changi and choose the two largest original images by pixel count. The rule and hashes were fixed before generated outputs.
validity_guards: frozen identity and unique attempt directory; the first technically valid attempt is the only scientific result and a valid row may not be rerun
complete two-batch archive and independent full-array cache-consumption readback

planned pose/K are read only from batch_input occurrence 0/1 retained targets and cross-checked to cache_commit rows; centered/transformed condition and sampler c2w cannot be substituted, while K is cross-checked under its own unchanged-coordinate semantics
actual c2w/K sequence and exact-return closure within 1e-6
authoritative pixels are cache_commit occurrence 1 cache.pil_frames[id].pixels uint8 tensor blobs, never an interchangeable PNG/live-PIL/cache snapshot
complete ID-to-image mapping, tensor descriptor/blob hashes, 147456 mask pixels, 442368 RGB scalars, and unrounded float64 MSE/PSNR
machine score receipt before human output inspection
no row deletion, replacement, or B0-based early stopping after any result
before A0/A1, a separately frozen independent visual camera-compliance proxy must pass and global visual collapse must not explain the discrepancy

evidence_classes.true_reference_rgb: ID0 is an observed RGB reference only for the exact returned initial camera condition and frozen mask; it is not 3D, depth, motion, or whole-video ground truth.
evidence_classes.no_gt_pair_consistency: Pairs 1/7, 2/6, and 3/5 compare two generated images and are diagnostic only.
evidence_classes.camera_compliance: Archived c2w/K validate requested conditions, not rendered visual camera obedience. No independent real camera-output GT is claimed.
evidence_classes.visual_quality: All nine frames must be inspected/reported without case selection; visual QA cannot replace the headline metric.
